pullRequests.title: fix(h5): settle getVideoInfo when video loading fails
pullRequests.body:
**这个 PR 做了什么？**

When the video element emits `error` before metadata loads, H5 `getVideoInfo` currently leaves its Promise pending and never calls `fail` or `complete`. Handle that error through `MethodHandler.fail`, using the media error message when available and a fallback otherwise.

Register listeners before setting `src`, and clear both listeners after the first metadata/error event so repeated events cannot trigger duplicate callbacks or fetches. Preserve the existing successful metadata/fetch behavior and fetch rejection handling.

Closes #19545

pullRequests.title: feat(mcp): support autoindex prefixes in xerj_search
pullRequests.body:
Written by an AI coding agent (OpenAI Codex), run by @Jarvis636431.

`xerj_search` ignored the CLI-style `prefix` argument and searched the default `ax-*` corpus. It now accepts `{"prefix":"project","query":"retry policy"}` and searches `project-*`, using that same scope for mapping discovery and the final search. The expansion follows `engine/crates/xerj-autoindex/src/search.rs:692`.

Non-empty `index` and `prefix` are mutually exclusive. Empty or non-string prefixes return an MCP tool error before any HTTP request; surrounding whitespace is trimmed and null is treated as omitted. Existing explicit-index and default `ax-*` behavior is preserved. `prefix` is not forwarded into the ES request body. README, changelog, and the generated MCP schema document the argument.

Refs #2080 — **prefix support only**. The local `xerj_def` request remains unimplemented; this PR should not close the issue.

### Verified

- Before the production change, `cargo test --locked -p xerj-mcp --lib search_prefix -- --nocapture` failed all four new tests: the builder used `/ax-*/_search`, mapping discovery used `GET /ax-*/_mapping`, conflicting scope arguments were accepted, and invalid arguments attempted HTTP.
- On the final rc.98 tree composed with upstream `28de5cfc`, `TMPDIR=/private/tmp cargo test --locked --offline -p xerj-mcp` passed all 124 tests: 117 library tests and 7 integration/schema tests, with 0 failures. The new real-node test seeds both `project-docs` and `ax-other` with matching text and checks custom prefix, default scope, and explicit index for plain-string and DSL queries. The transport tests independently check both HTTP paths and zero requests on invalid scope arguments. A new combination regression proves prefix-scoped code searches retain upstream's test-path demotion.
- `TMPDIR=/private/tmp cargo test --locked --offline --profile ci-test -p xerj-mcp --lib search_prefix` passed all 5 focused regressions on the composed tree in the optimized CI test profile.
- `cargo fmt --all`, `cargo fmt --all --check`, and `cargo clippy --locked --offline -p xerj-mcp --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.
- `cargo build --locked --offline --release -j 32 -p xerj-mcp` passed on the composed tree.
- `cargo build --locked --offline --profile ci-test -j 8 -p xerj-server -p es-yaml-runner` passed on the final rc.98 tree. Against the candidate server in a fresh temporary data directory, `./target/ci-test/es-yaml-runner --url <isolated-loopback-node> --dir tests/es-compat-yaml/yaml` completed with **1438 passed, 0 failed, 10 skipped** (exit 0), including 75 cases under the existing catch-lenient policy. The node stopped normally (exit 0).
- `scripts/mcp-schema-check.sh --write` regenerated the schema from the candidate debug `xerj-mcp`; subsequent checks against both debug and release binaries passed with the same 20 tools. On this macOS host a temporary Python timeout wrapper supplied the script's missing `timeout` command; no repository script was changed.

### Environment and site checks

The first library-test run with the host's default temporary directory failed the existing `loopback_url_with_no_auth_picks_up_the_local_admin_key` assertion because `/var/...` and `/private/var/...` were compared as strings. The complete crate suite passed with `TMPDIR=/private/tmp`; that unrelated test was not changed.

All applicable SEO workflow checks, factcheck fixture/self-tests and content checks, the critical-level site audit, and the landing constants guard passed. After the rc.98 merge was committed, `gen_sitemap.py --check` matched and `seo_lint.py` reported 0 gate violations. No additional website changes were needed beyond the generated tool schema.

### Review and limits

Started independently from upstream main `e1348b4d`, then merged upstream search fixes and the rc.98 release, ending at base `28de5cfc`. The mapping-read overlap preserves upstream's plain-query detection and ranking path while using the resolved prefix scope for the GET. The later description/schema overlap preserves the new upstream removal tool and deletion guidance. The prefix changelog entry stays under Unreleased, not the rc.98 release. The effective diff remains five files containing only the prefix feature, its tests, docs, and generated schema. No new dependencies or tool names. Scope resolution is shared by mapping discovery and request construction, and the request is read-only. Existing index selection, DSL forwarding, lexical query shaping, auth, token budgets, and recovery behavior are preserved.

No stored-state schema, journal, migration, publication lifecycle, telemetry, execution identity, optimization, feature gate, cluster behavior, or operational recipe changes. The durable-state/migration, optional-accelerator, identity, telemetry, feature-gate, performance, cluster, and operational-recipe audits are therefore not applicable. Tests use isolated temporary data directories and loopback endpoints; no external models or corpus downloads are required by the new coverage.

Not verified: Windows/Linux execution or external MCP clients. No performance claims; no claim that #2080's definition-lookup work is complete.

pullRequests.title: feat(confluence): support personal access token authentication
pullRequests.body:
## Description

Confluence Server/Data Center instances that require personal access tokens cannot connect through the current username/password-only connector.

Accept an optional `credentials.token` for Server/DC. A nonblank PAT takes precedence over username/password and sends `Authorization: Bearer <token>` for API requests and private image downloads; username and password may be omitted. An absent or whitespace-only PAT retains Basic authentication. Cloud continues to require email and API token.

- Partition the space-picker cache by authentication mode and credential fingerprint.
- Add a masked PAT input, conditional required fields, and translations in all six locales. Creation and credential replacement keep the token out of public settings.
- Document configuration and include a screenshot of the actual editor rendered with local mock configuration.

No schema migration or dependency change.

pullRequests.title: fix(h5): prevent uploads after cancellation during file conversion
pullRequests.body:
**这个 PR 做了什么？**

Fixes cancellation while H5 uploadFile is still converting its blob URL. Previously, aborting before POST send could leave the task pending and the conversion continuation would still send the upload. The task now settles immediately on cancellation and ignores late conversion results.

A shared terminal-state guard clears the timeout and XHR handlers before invoking callbacks, preventing duplicate completion after abort, timeout, errors or success.

Regression coverage includes cancellation before conversion resolves/rejects, repeated cancellation, and success/error/abort/timeout/conversion-failure cleanup. File conversion failures preserve HTTP status values returned by the blob conversion helper instead of reporting an undefined message. The new tests fail against the original implementation.

pullRequests.title: fix(h5): cancel pending sensor callbacks when stopping listeners
pullRequests.body:
**这个 PR 做了什么？**

Cancel pending throttled callbacks when stopping H5 accelerometer, device motion and compass listeners. Previously, removing the DOM listener left a trailing invocation queued, so callbacks could fire after stop or from an old listener after restart.

Each stop method now removes the DOM listener, cancels its throttle and releases the listener reference. Application subscriptions are preserved across stop/start cycles.

Adds 9 regression tests covering queued callbacks after stop, restart, repeated stop and subscription preservation. The original implementation fails 6 of these tests.

## Description
The built-in MCP `read_document` schema describes query matching as phrase search and implies that `limit` also controls query results. pullRequests.title: fix(runtime): correct alias after removing event listener
pullRequests.body:
**这个 PR 做了什么？**

修复小程序端 `Text` 和 `Image` 节点移除最后一个事件监听器时，运行时访问不存在的 `pure-text` / `pure-image` alias 导致崩溃的问题。

`hydrate()` 初始化无事件节点时遵循以下规则：

- 无提取属性的 `View` 使用 `pure-view`
- 其他 `View`、`Text`、`Image` 使用对应的 `static-*` alias

但 `removeEventListener()` 原先会将所有无提取属性的特殊节点切换为 `pure-*`，导致 `Text` 和 `Image` 分别访问不存在的 `pure-text` 和 `pure-image`。

本次修改使 `removeEventListener()` 的 alias 选择逻辑与 `hydrate()` 保持一致：

- `View` 且无提取属性：`pure-view`
- 其他特殊节点：`static-${nodeName}`

同时增加回归测试，覆盖：

- `Text` 移除最后一个事件监听器后切换到 `static-text`
- `Image` 移除最后一个事件监听器后切换到 `static-image`
- 无提取属性的 `View` 切换到 `pure-view`
- 有提取属性的 `View` 切换到 `static-view`
- 节点仍有其他监听器时不切换模板
